# S20 — Docs refresh: PRIVACY, README, DEVELOPERS, Play data-safety draft, docs/ site

**Findings:** PRIVACY.md; DEVELOPERS.md; docs/index.html · **Size:** M · **Tree:** docs

**Not in this slice:** fastlane listing text and screenshots (S49), publishing GitHub Pages or submitting to F-Droid or Google Play (owner actions), and any code change.

## Why

- Play needs a privacy-policy URL and a data-safety form, and F-Droid needs accurate documentation. PRIVACY.md and the developer docs describe the MVP before the later slices changed behaviour.
- Documentation must match the shipped behaviour exactly, because the privacy policy is a promise to users.

## Implement

Do this last in the release sequence, after the behaviour it describes is merged.

1. `PRIVACY.md`: state only what is true when the slice is done, and check each line against the code and the merged manifest:
   - The app requests no network permission (confirm the merged manifest lists only `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` and `RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED`).
   - Reminders are local notifications and may arrive a few minutes late.
   - Exports are unencrypted, written where the user chooses, and not tracked by the app.
   - Importing a backup first saves your previous data to the app's private storage (the last three copies are kept there) and replaces the current data.
   - Deleting a tracker permanently removes its entries and reminder.
   - Automatic Android backup and device transfer are disabled.
   - No accounts, analytics or ads.
   - Update the "Last updated" date.
2. `README.md`: update the feature list to what exists (today-first dashboard with one-tap logging and undo, charts, calendar, archive and delete, save-to-file export).
3. `BUILDING.md` and `DEVELOPERS.md`: update the SDK version numbers, the test commands (`./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug`, and `./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest` on a device or emulator), the "Persistence Notes" (schema version 1 with exported schemas, from S05), and the Manual QA checklist (point to S22's table).
4. `DEVELOPERS.md`, "Release checklist": version rules (S19), signing (S47), the tag and release workflow (S21), and a draft of the Google Play data-safety answers: no data collected, no data shared, no data transferred off the device by the app, and data removed by uninstalling.
5. `docs/index.html`: make it a self-contained page (plain HTML and CSS, no scripts, no external requests) containing the privacy policy text from `PRIVACY.md`, so GitHub Pages can serve it as the policy URL. Do not enable Pages. Record in `DEVELOPERS.md` that the owner turns it on and what the resulting URL will be.
6. `CHANGELOG.md`: Keep a Changelog format, with an initial `1.0.0` entry listing the features. This text also seeds the fastlane changelog in S49.
7. Re-read the F-Droid section of `DEVELOPERS.md` and remove anything that is no longer accurate.
